definitions.gloss: in great demand; very popular; sought after by everyone
definitions.explanation: Describes a person or thing that is extremely popular and wanted by many people at the same time. Often used when someone is so in demand that they are being pulled in all directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りだこだ。
examples.english: She is in great demand right now.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りだこになった。
examples.english: That singer became extremely popular on TV.

examples.japanese: IT⟦{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}→技術者：17049_gijutsusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{各社|かくしゃ}→各社：11057_kakusha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りだこ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Due to the labor shortage, IT engineers continue to be in high demand from every company.

notes:
An idiomatic expression meaning someone or something is so popular and sought-after that everyone is trying to get them. The word literally comes from the image of a dried octopus (⟦{蛸|たこ}→蛸：04323_tako⟧) being stretched out (⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧) with its legs pulled in all directions.

USAGE:
Typically used as a predicate with だ or ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧. Most commonly describes people (performers, professionals, experts) but can also describe products or services.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りだこだ: is in great demand
- {引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りだこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become very popular
- {引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りだこの⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: a state of being in great demand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人気者|にんきもの}→人気者：19887_ninkimono⟧: popular person — describes general popularity, without the sense of being pulled in every direction
- ⟦{売|う}れっ{子|こ}→売れっ子：12110_urekko⟧: in-demand person — specifically for professionals whose services are highly sought
